This '''Clone Captain '''served on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Fugitive" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|603}}</ref> this trooper was tasked with tracking down [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Clone]] [[Fives/Legends|CT-5555]], nicknamed "Fives", who had gone rogue shortly after learning of [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|Inhibitor chips]] placed within the minds of all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="Fugitive" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
This Clone Captain was equipped with [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] adorned with dark gray markings, a [[Kama/Legends|''kama'']] and a visor with an [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] "C" painted on the sides.<ref name="Fugitive" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The script calls him a captain.|Pablo Hidalgo, on the character's name in the script|<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|Pabl0hidalgo|status/1553849057021308928|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=The script calls him a captain.|archivedate=20220802192012}}</ref>}}
The clone trooper commander debuted, albeit unnamed, in the [[Fugitive|third episode]] of the [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Fugitive" /> The episode aired on [[February 15]], [[2014]],<ref name="German TV Schedule">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fernsehserien.de/star-wars-the-clone-wars/episodenguide/staffel-6/9660|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars Staffel 6 Episodenguide|work=[http://www.fernsehserien.de fernsehserien.de]|language=German|archivedate=20190419012747}}</ref> and was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]<ref name="Fugitive" /> like all clones in ''The Clone Wars''.<ref name="DBB:FCtQK">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091120.html|text=Dee Bradley Baker: From Clones to Queen Karina}}</ref> The clone trooper is identified as a captain in the script.<ref name="Twitter" />
